newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint rises vs dlr, steady at NBH bid.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint rises vs dlr, steady at NBH bid.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar after tracking the dollar/mark cross all day and remaining at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid), dealers said.
The forint finished at 176.00/05, compared with 176.20/25 at midday and the opening level of 176.50/55.
"We moved together with the dollar/mark completely," said Andras Szanto of Europai Kereskelmi Bank.
Trading was slow with sporadic deals and a turnover too low to give the forint impetus to move away from the central bank's bid, dealers said.
They added that in the near future the forint was unlikely to ease relative to the NBH basket, which is made up 30 percent of the dollar and seventy percent of the mark.
"I do not see anything on the domestic market which could move the forint away," said Csaba Fonad of Corvinbank. "It will remain pinned to the NBH bid in the near future.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range.
